judgment.rationale: The submission follows the operative record. It requires Finance, Program and Purchase approval for every price change, per the in-force revision 2, and states that the Purchase-only draft is not operative. It keeps the ER/Quality/Purchase TRSO signoff and the nomination signoffs from Finance, Quality, ER and Program. The modular quotation structure covers features, design elements, child parts and raw materials, with module IDs and revisions, a pricing formula and shared-cost handling. Version control and immutable approval history are included, and so are release blocking when approvals are missing and invalidation of pending approvals when the package changes. The late-change path is practical, with parallel assessment, routing by change scope, and reuse of valid modules. Agility is gained without removing any mandatory gate. Unapproved thresholds and unmeasured improvements are left open rather than invented. I found no material omissions or errors. Page length was not assessed.
